QUOTE: `data` ... Cleared by: A rebuild; `code` ... Cleared by: Restarting the MCP client only; "A rebuild through this process will not clear it"; "The design rule behind all of this is that a rebuild through a stale process is never attempted... The refusal is cheap, since one client reconnect fixes it."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that data is cleared by a rebuild and code by a client restart. It never says that this difference is why a single flag would not have been enough.
